verses.kjv: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
verses.modern: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

verses.kjv: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
verses.modern: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

verses.kjv: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.modern: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

verses.kjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.modern: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.modern: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.modern: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.modern: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.kjv: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.modern: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.modern: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.modern: Cush begat Nimrod. He was the first to be a mighty man on the earth.

verses.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.modern: Mizraim begat Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

verses.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
verses.modern: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom the Philistines came), and Caphtorim.

verses.kjv: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.modern: Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.kjv: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.modern: The Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

verses.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.modern: The Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

verses.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.modern: The Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.modern: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

verses.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.modern: Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

verses.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.modern: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother's name was Joktan.

verses.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.modern: Joktan begat Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.kjv: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.modern: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.kjv: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.modern: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.modern: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.kjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.modern: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

verses.kjv: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.modern: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.kjv: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.modern: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

verses.kjv: Abram; the same is Abraham.
verses.modern: Abram, that is, Abraham.

verses.kjv: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.modern: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

verses.kjv: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.modern: These are their genealogies: the firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

verses.kjv: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.modern: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

verses.kjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.modern: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.modern: The sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.modern: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

verses.kjv: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.modern: Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.modern: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.modern: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

verses.kjv: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.modern: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
verses.modern: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
verses.modern: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Lotan's sister was Timna.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.modern: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.modern: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.kjv: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.modern: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.modern: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the people of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.kjv: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: When Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.modern: When Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the fields of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

verses.kjv: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: When Samlah died, Shaul of Rehoboth by the Euphrates reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.modern: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pai. his wife's name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.

verses.kjv: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.modern: Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timnah, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

verses.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.modern: Chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

verses.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.modern: Chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

verses.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
verses.modern: Chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

chapters.summary: The genealogy traces the line of the nations from Adam through Noah’s three sons, then narrows to Abraham through Esau and the chiefs of Edom.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.modern: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

verses.kjv: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.modern: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.kjv: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
verses.modern: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah — these three were born to Him by the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD. He put Him to death.

verses.kjv: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.modern: Tamar His daughter-in-law bore Him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

verses.kjv: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.modern: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.modern: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara — five in all.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.modern: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who broke faith in the matter of the devoted thing.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.modern: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

verses.kjv: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.modern: The sons of Hezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

verses.kjv: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.modern: Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the sons of Judah.

verses.kjv: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.modern: Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz.

verses.kjv: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.modern: Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse.

verses.kjv: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.modern: Jesse begat Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

verses.kjv: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.modern: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

verses.kjv: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.modern: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.

verses.kjv: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.modern: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel — three.

verses.kjv: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.modern: Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

verses.kjv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.modern: Caleb the son of Hezron begat children by Azubah his wife and by Jerioth. These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

verses.kjv: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.modern: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

verses.kjv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.modern: Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezalel.

verses.kjv: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.modern: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old. She bore him Segub.

verses.kjv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.modern: Segub begat Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.modern: He took Geshur and Aram, with the towns of Jair, along with Kenath and its villages — sixty towns in all. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
verses.modern: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron's wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.modern: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

verses.kjv: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.modern: Jerahmeel had another wife whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.modern: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.modern: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

verses.kjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.modern: The name of Abishur's wife was Abihail. She bore him Ahban and Molid.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.modern: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.modern: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.modern: The sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.modern: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.modern: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha.

verses.kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.modern: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife. She bore him Attai.

verses.kjv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.modern: Attai begat Nathan, Nathan begat Zabad,

verses.kjv: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.modern: Zabad begat Ephlal, Ephlal begat Obed,

verses.kjv: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.modern: Obed begat Jehu, Jehu begat Azariah,

verses.kjv: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.modern: Azariah begat Helez, Helez begat Eleasah,

verses.kjv: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.modern: Eleasah begat Sismai, Sismai begat Shallum,

verses.kjv: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.modern: Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.modern: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph. The sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.modern: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

verses.kjv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.modern: Shema begat Raham the father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begat Shammai.

verses.kjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
verses.modern: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

verses.kjv: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.modern: Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran begat Gazez.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.modern: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

verses.kjv: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.modern: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

verses.kjv: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.modern: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. The daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

verses.kjv: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
verses.modern: These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,

verses.kjv: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
verses.modern: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

verses.kjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
verses.modern: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites,

verses.kjv: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.modern: The families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

verses.kjv: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.modern: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

verses.kjv: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.modern: The families of the scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

chapters.summary: The genealogy traces the sons of Israel (Jacob), then focuses on the line of Judah through Perez and Hezron down to Jesse and David, with the clans of Caleb and Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.modern: These are the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelite; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite;

verses.kjv: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.modern: The third Absalom, whose mother was Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith;

verses.kjv: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.modern: The fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by his wife Eglah.

verses.kjv: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.modern: Six were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned for seven years and six months. Then he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.modern: These were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon — four by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

verses.kjv: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.modern: Then Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

verses.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.modern: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.kjv: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.modern: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet — nine.

verses.kjv: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.modern: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines. Tamar was their sister.

verses.kjv: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.modern: Solomon's son was Rehoboam; Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

verses.kjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.modern: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

verses.kjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.modern: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

verses.kjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.modern: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

verses.kjv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.modern: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.modern: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.modern: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.modern: The sons of Jeconiah the captive: Assir, Shealtiel his son,

verses.kjv: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.modern: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.modern: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;

verses.kjv: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
verses.modern: Also Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed — five.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.modern: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.modern: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat — six.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.modern: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam — three.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.modern: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani — seven.

chapters.summary: The genealogy lists the sons of David born in Hebron and Jerusalem, then traces the royal line from Solomon through the kings of Judah down to the descendants of Jeconiah after the exile.

verses.kjv: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.modern: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

verses.kjv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.modern: Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath, and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

verses.kjv: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
verses.modern: These were the sons of Etam's father: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;

verses.kjv: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.modern: Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.modern: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

verses.kjv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.modern: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.modern: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

verses.kjv: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.modern: Koz begat Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

verses.kjv: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.modern: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, "I bore him in pain."

verses.kjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.modern: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, "Oh that you would bless me and enlarge my territory, and that your hand would be with me, and that you would keep me from harm so that it might not bring me pain!" And God granted what He requested.

verses.kjv: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
verses.modern: Chelub the brother of Shuhah begat Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

verses.kjv: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.modern: Eshton begat Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.modern: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The son of Othniel: Hathath.

verses.kjv: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.modern: Meonothai begat Ophrah. Seraiah begat Joab the father of Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.modern: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.modern: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.modern: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. She conceived and bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.kjv: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.modern: his wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

verses.kjv: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.modern: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
verses.modern: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.modern: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of linen workers at Beth-ashbea;

verses.kjv: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
verses.modern: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubilehem (now these are ancient records).

verses.kjv: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.modern: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges. They lived there with the king in his service.

verses.kjv: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
verses.modern: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul;

verses.kjv: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.modern: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.modern: The son of Mishma: Hamuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

verses.kjv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.modern: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many children, nor did all their family multiply like the sons of Judah.

verses.kjv: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
verses.modern: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,

verses.kjv: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.modern: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,

verses.kjv: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.modern: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,

verses.kjv: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.modern: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.

verses.kjv: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.modern: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan — five cities —

verses.kjv: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.modern: Along with all the villages around these cities as far as Baal. These were their settlements. They kept a genealogical record.

verses.kjv: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.modern: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

verses.kjv: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.modern: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, son of Seraiah, son of Asiel,

verses.kjv: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.modern: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

verses.kjv: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.modern: Ziza the son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah —

verses.kjv: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and their families increased greatly.
verses.modern: These mentioned by name were leaders in their families. Their families increased greatly.

verses.kjv: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.modern: They went to the entrance of Gedor as far as the eastern side of the valley to seek pasture for their flocks.

verses.kjv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.modern: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was broad, quiet, and peaceful, for the former inhabitants there belonged to Ham.

verses.kjv: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.modern: These, recorded by name, came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and smote their tents and the habitations that were found there, and devoted them to destruction to this day, and settled in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

verses.kjv: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.modern: Some of them, five hundred men of the tribe of Simeon, went to Mount Seir with Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel — sons of Ishi — as their leaders.

verses.kjv: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.modern: They defeated the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and have lived there to this day.

chapters.summary: The genealogy continues the clans of Judah, including the prayer of Jabez who asked God to enlarge his territory, and records the families and settlements of Simeon.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.modern: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel — he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, so that he is not enrolled in the genealogy according to the birthright.

verses.kjv: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)
verses.modern: For Judah prevailed among his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright belonged to Joseph —

verses.kjv: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.modern: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.kjv: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.modern: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

verses.kjv: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.modern: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

verses.kjv: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.modern: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried into exile; he was a chief of the Reubenites.

verses.kjv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.modern: His kinsmen by their clans, when their genealogy was recorded by generations: Jeiel the chief, and Zechariah,

verses.kjv: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
verses.modern: Bela the son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.

verses.kjv: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.modern: He also lived to the east as far as the beginning of the wilderness toward the Euphrates, because their livestock had multiplied in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
verses.modern: In the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who fell by their hand. They lived in their tents throughout all the region east of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
verses.modern: The sons of Gad lived opposite them in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:

verses.kjv: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.modern: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

verses.kjv: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.modern: Their kinsmen of their fathers' houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber — seven.

verses.kjv: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.modern: These were the sons of Abihail the son of Huri, son of Jaroah, son of Gilead, son of Michael, son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz;

verses.kjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: Ahi the son of Abdiel, son of Guni — chief of their fathers' households.

verses.kjv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
verses.modern: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and in all the pasturelands of Sharon to their limits.

verses.kjv: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.modern: All of these were enrolled by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
verses.modern: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had valiant men who carried shield and sword, drew the bow, and were skillful in war: forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty, ready for battle.

verses.kjv: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.modern: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

verses.kjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.modern: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were given into their hands, and all who were with them, for they cried to God in the battle. He answered their prayer because they trusted in Him.

verses.kjv: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand; and of men an hundred thousand.
verses.modern: They took captive their livestock: fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and a hundred thousand human lives.

verses.kjv: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.modern: For many fell slain, because the war was from God. And they lived in their land until the exile.

verses.kjv: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.modern: The members of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They were very numerous from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

verses.kjv: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: These were the heads of their fathers' houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty warriors, famous men, heads of their fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.modern: But they broke faith with the God of their fathers and went a whoring after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

verses.kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.modern: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria. He carried them into exile — the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh — and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river Gozan, where they are to this day.

chapters.summary: The genealogy records the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan, noting their victories in war and their later exile by Assyria for unfaithfulness.

verses.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.modern: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.modern: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.modern: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.modern: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

verses.kjv: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.modern: Abishua begat Bukki, Bukki begat Uzzi,

verses.kjv: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.modern: Uzzi begat Zerahiah, Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

verses.kjv: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.modern: Meraioth begat Amariah, Amariah begat Ahitub,

verses.kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.modern: Ahitub begat Zadok, Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

verses.kjv: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.modern: Ahimaaz begat Azariah, Azariah begat Johanan,

verses.kjv: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.modern: Johanan begat Azariah — it was he who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem —

verses.kjv: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.modern: Azariah begat Amariah, Amariah begat Ahitub,

verses.kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.modern: Ahitub begat Zadok, Zadok begat Shallum,

verses.kjv: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.modern: Shallum begat Hilkiah, Hilkiah begat Azariah,

verses.kjv: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.modern: Azariah begat Seraiah, Seraiah begat Jehozadak;

verses.kjv: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.modern: Jehozadak went into exile when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.modern: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.modern: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.modern: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.modern: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

verses.kjv: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.modern: Of Gershom: Libni His son, Jahath His son, Zimmah His son,

verses.kjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.modern: Joah His son, Iddo His son, Zerah His son, Jeatherai His son.

verses.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.modern: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab His son, Korah His son, Assir His son,

verses.kjv: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.modern: Elkanah His son, Ebiasaph His son, Assir His son,

verses.kjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.modern: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.modern: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

verses.kjv: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.modern: As for Elkanah: his son Zophai, his son Nahath,

verses.kjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.modern: His son Eliab, his son Jeroham, his son Elkanah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.modern: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.modern: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

verses.kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.modern: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

verses.kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
verses.modern: These are the men whom David put in charge of the service of song in the house of the LORD after the ark came to rest.

verses.kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.modern: They ministered with song before the tent of meeting until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. They performed their service in the proper order.

verses.kjv: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.modern: These are those who served with their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

verses.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.modern: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

verses.kjv: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.modern: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

verses.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.modern: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

verses.kjv: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.modern: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

verses.kjv: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.modern: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

verses.kjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.modern: His brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

verses.kjv: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.modern: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

verses.kjv: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.modern: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.modern: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

verses.kjv: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.modern: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

verses.kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.modern: Their brothers the sons of Merari stood at the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

verses.kjv: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.modern: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.modern: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

verses.kjv: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.modern: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

verses.kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.modern: Their brothers the Levites were appointed to all the other service of the tent of the house of God.

verses.kjv: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.modern: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense — all the work of the most holy place — to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.modern: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

verses.kjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.modern: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

verses.kjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.modern: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

verses.kjv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.modern: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

verses.kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.modern: These are their dwelling places according to their settlements in their territory: to the sons of Aaron of the Kohathite clan, for theirs was the first lot —

verses.kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.modern: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.

verses.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.modern: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.modern: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah with its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Hilen with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
verses.modern: Ashan with its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.modern: From the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its pasturelands, Alemeth with its pasturelands, and Anathoth with its pasturelands. All their cities throughout their clans were thirteen cities.

verses.kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.modern: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot ten cities from the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.modern: To the sons of Gershom, throughout their clans, were given thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.modern: To the sons of Merari were given by lot twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
verses.modern: So the people of Israel gave the Levites these cities with their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
verses.modern: They gave by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin the cities that are mentioned by name.

verses.kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.modern: Some of the clans of the sons of Kohath had cities from the tribe of Ephraim as their territory.

verses.kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.modern: They were given the cities of refuge: Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasturelands, Gezer with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Jokmeam with its pasturelands, Beth-horon with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
verses.modern: Aijalon with its pasturelands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.modern: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its pasturelands and Bileam with its pasturelands, for the rest of the clan of the sons of Kohath.

verses.kjv: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.modern: To the sons of Gershom were given from the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands and Ashtaroth with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.modern: From the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasturelands, Daberath with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.modern: Ramoth with its pasturelands, and Anem with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.modern: From the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasturelands, Abdon with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.modern: Hukok with its pasturelands, and Rehob with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.modern: From the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, Hammon with its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with its pasturelands.

verses.kjv: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.modern: To the rest of the sons of Merari were given from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono with its pasturelands, Tabor with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasturelands, Jahzah with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.modern: Kedemoth with its pasturelands, and Mephaath with its pasturelands;

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.modern: From the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands, Mahanaim with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.modern: Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Jazer with its pasturelands.

chapters.summary: The genealogy traces the line of Levi through his three sons, lists the descendants of Aaron the high priest, records the Levitical singers appointed by David, and assigns the Levitical cities.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.modern: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron — four.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.modern: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers' houses. The descendants of Tola were mighty warriors in their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.modern: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah — five, all of them chief men.

verses.kjv: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.modern: Along with them, by their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were bands of warriors for battle, thirty-six thousand, for they had many wives and sons.

verses.kjv: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.modern: Their brothers throughout all the clans of Issachar were mighty warriors, enrolled by genealogy in all — eighty-seven thousand.

verses.kjv: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.modern: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael — three.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.modern: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri — five heads of fathers' houses, mighty warriors. They were enrolled by genealogy: twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
verses.modern: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

verses.kjv: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.modern: Their enrollment by genealogy, according to their generations, as heads of their fathers' houses, mighty warriors: twenty thousand two hundred.

verses.kjv: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.modern: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

verses.kjv: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
verses.modern: All these were sons of Jediael, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty warriors — seventeen thousand two hundred men fit to go to war.

verses.kjv: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.modern: Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir; Hushim was the son of Aher.

verses.kjv: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.modern: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.modern: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his Aramean concubine bore; she bore Machir the father of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.modern: Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim. The name of his sister was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters.

verses.kjv: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.modern: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son. She named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh. His sons were Ulam and Rakem.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.modern: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.modern: His sister Hammoleketh bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.modern: The sons of Shemida were: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.modern: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

verses.kjv: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.modern: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead — whom the men of Gath who were born in that land killed, because they came down to raid their livestock.

verses.kjv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.modern: Ephraim their father mourned for many days. His brothers came to comfort him.

verses.kjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.modern: He went in to his wife. She conceived and bore a son. And he called his name Beriah, because disaster had come upon his house.

verses.kjv: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
verses.modern: His daughter was Sheerah, who built both Lower and Upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sheerah.

verses.kjv: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.modern: Rephah was his son, and Resheph his son, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

verses.kjv: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.modern: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.kjv: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.
verses.modern: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

verses.kjv: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Azzah and the towns thereof:
verses.modern: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its towns to the west, Shechem and its towns, and Ayyah and its towns;

verses.kjv: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.modern: Along the borders of Manasseh: Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the sons of Joseph the son of Israel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.modern: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.modern: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

verses.kjv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.modern: Heber begat Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.modern: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.modern: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

verses.kjv: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.modern: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

verses.kjv: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.modern: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

verses.kjv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.modern: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.modern: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.modern: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

verses.kjv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.modern: All of these were the sons of Asher, heads of fathers' houses, selected, mighty warriors, chief among the princes. Their enrollment by genealogy for service in war: twenty-six thousand men.

chapters.summary: The genealogy records the descendants of Issachar, Benjamin, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, and Asher, noting their mighty warriors and their numbers.

verses.kjv: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.modern: Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

verses.kjv: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.modern: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.modern: The sons of Bela: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

verses.kjv: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.modern: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

verses.kjv: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.modern: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.modern: These are the sons of Ehud — these are the heads of fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried into exile to Manahath:

verses.kjv: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.modern: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera — he carried them into exile. He begat Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.kjv: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.modern: Shaharaim begat sons in the land of Moab after he had sent away his wives Hushim and Baara.

verses.kjv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.modern: He begat by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

verses.kjv: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.modern: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.modern: Of Hushim he begat Abitub and Elpaal.

verses.kjv: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.modern: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod with its towns;

verses.kjv: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.modern: Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath;

verses.kjv: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.modern: Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth.

verses.kjv: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.modern: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

verses.kjv: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.modern: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were sons of Beriah;

verses.kjv: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.modern: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

verses.kjv: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.modern: Ishmerai, Jezliah, and Jobab were sons of Elpaal;

verses.kjv: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.modern: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

verses.kjv: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.modern: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

verses.kjv: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.modern: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were sons of Shimei;

verses.kjv: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.modern: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

verses.kjv: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.modern: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

verses.kjv: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.modern: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

verses.kjv: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.modern: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were sons of Shashak;

verses.kjv: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.modern: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

verses.kjv: And Jaresiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.modern: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were sons of Jeroham.

verses.kjv: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: These were heads of fathers' houses, by their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.modern: At Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon — his wife's name was Maacah —

verses.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.modern: His firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

verses.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.modern: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

verses.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.modern: Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem, along with their brothers.

verses.kjv: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.modern: Ner begat Kish, Kish begat Saul, Saul begat Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.modern: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal begat Micah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.modern: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.modern: Ahaz begat Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah begat Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri begat Moza.

verses.kjv: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.modern: Moza begat Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

verses.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.modern: Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.modern: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.modern: The sons of Ulam were mighty warriors, archers, and had many sons and grandsons — one hundred fifty. All these were Benjamin's sons.

chapters.summary: The genealogy traces the descendants of Benjamin in detail, including the house of Saul through Kish and Jonathan down to their later generations.

verses.kjv: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.modern: So all Israel was enrolled by genealogies, and these are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was carried away into exile in Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.

verses.kjv: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.modern: Now the first to live again in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinims.

verses.kjv: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh;
verses.modern: In Jerusalem lived some of the sons of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh:

verses.kjv: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.modern: Uthai the son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Perez the son of Judah;

verses.kjv: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.modern: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons;

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.modern: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah;

verses.kjv: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.modern: Ibneiah the son of Jeroham; Elah the son of Uzzi, son of Michri; Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah;

verses.kjv: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: Their brothers, according to their generations — nine hundred fifty-six. All these were heads of fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.modern: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

verses.kjv: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.modern: Azariah the son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub — the chief officer of the house of God;

verses.kjv: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.modern: Adaiah the son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah. Maasai the son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer;

verses.kjv: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.modern: Their brothers, heads of their fathers' houses — one thousand seven hundred sixty, very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.modern: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

verses.kjv: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.modern: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;

verses.kjv: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
