verses.modern: Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun. Berechiah the son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

verses.kjv: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
verses.modern: The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman. Their brothers; Shallum was the chief.

verses.kjv: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.modern: He was until then stationed at the King's Gate on the east side; they were the gatekeepers of the camp of the sons of Levi.

verses.kjv: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.
verses.modern: Shallum the son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah. His brothers of His fathers' house, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, gatekeepers of the tent, as their fathers had been in charge of the camp of the LORD, keepers of the entrance.

verses.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
verses.modern: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was their ruler in time past. The LORD was with Him.

verses.kjv: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.modern: All these, who were chosen as gatekeepers in the gates, were two hundred twelve. They were enrolled by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer established them in their appointed office.

verses.kjv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.modern: So they and their sons were in charge of the gates of the house of the LORD, the house of the tent, by divisions.

verses.kjv: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.modern: The gatekeepers were posted on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.

verses.kjv: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.modern: Their brothers in their villages were to come in every seven days in turn to be with them.

verses.kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.modern: For the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in a position of trust, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
verses.modern: They lodged around the house of God, for that duty was on them. They had charge of opening it each morning.

verses.kjv: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.modern: Some of them had charge of the ministering vessels, counting them as they were brought in and taken out.

verses.kjv: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.modern: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture and all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the incense, and the spices.

verses.kjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.modern: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

verses.kjv: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.modern: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was in charge of the things that were baked in pans.

verses.kjv: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.modern: Some of their brothers of the sons of the Kohathites were over the bread of the Presence, to prepare it every Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.modern: These are the singers, heads of fathers' houses of the Levites, who lived in the chambers of the temple and were free from other service, for they were on duty day and night.

verses.kjv: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: These were the heads of fathers' houses of the Levites, chiefs according to their generations; they lived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.modern: The father of Gibeon, Jeiel, lived in Gibeon. his wife's name was Maacah.

verses.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.modern: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

verses.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.modern: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.modern: Mikloth begat Shimeam. And these also lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem, with their brothers.

verses.kjv: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.modern: Ner begat Kish, Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.modern: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal begat Micah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.modern: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.modern: Ahaz begat Jarah, and Jarah begat Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri begat Moza.

verses.kjv: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.modern: Moza begat Binea. Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

verses.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.modern: Azel had six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

chapters.summary: The genealogy lists the first inhabitants who resettled Jerusalem after the exile — from Judah, Benjamin, the priests, and the Levites — and details the duties of the gatekeepers, with Saul’s family line repeated.

verses.kjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.modern: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.modern: The Philistines pressed hard after Saul and his sons, and the Philistines struck down Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

verses.kjv: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.modern: The battle pressed hard against Saul, and the archers found him. He was wounded by the archers.

verses.kjv: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.modern: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through with it, lest these uncircumcised men come and mistreat me." But his armor-bearer would not, for he was very afraid. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

verses.kjv: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.modern: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword and died.

verses.kjv: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.modern: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

verses.kjv: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.modern: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled, and the Philistines came and lived in them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.modern: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.modern: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to carry the good news to their idols and to the people.

verses.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.modern: They put his armor in the house of their gods and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

verses.kjv: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.modern: When all the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.kjv: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.modern: All the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh. They buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted for seven days.

verses.kjv: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
verses.modern: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness that he committed against the LORD, because of the word of the LORD that He did not keep, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

verses.kjv: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.modern: He did not seek guidance from the LORD. Therefore He put Him to death and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

chapters.summary: The Philistines defeated Israel on Mount Gilboa; Saul and his three sons were killed. Saul died for his unfaithfulness against the LORD, and the kingdom was turned over to David.

verses.kjv: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.modern: Then all Israel gathered to David at Hebron, saying, "We are your bone and flesh.

verses.kjv: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.modern: Even before, when Saul was king, it was you who led Israel in battle and brought them home. And the LORD Your God said to You, 'You shall shepherd my people Israel, and You shall be prince over my people Israel.' "

verses.kjv: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
verses.modern: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD. And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

verses.kjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.modern: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, that is, Jebus, where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.modern: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You will not come in here." But David took the stronghold of Zion, that is, the city of David.

verses.kjv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.modern: David had said, "Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and commander." And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief.

verses.kjv: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.modern: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.

verses.kjv: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.modern: He built the city all around, from the Millo in complete circuit, and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

verses.kjv: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
verses.modern: David became greater and greater, for the LORD of hosts was with Him.

verses.kjv: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.modern: These are the chiefs of David's mighty men who gave him strong support in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make Him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

verses.kjv: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.modern: This is an account of David's mighty men: Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, the chief of the captains — he wielded his spear against three hundred whom he killed at one time.

verses.kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.modern: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite. He was one of the three mighty men.

verses.kjv: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.modern: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. There was a plot of ground full of barley, and the people had fled before the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.modern: But they took their stand in the middle of the plot and defended it and struck down the Philistines. And the LORD saved them by a great victory.

verses.kjv: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.modern: Three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David at the cave of Adullam, while the army of the Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
verses.modern: David was then in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was then at Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
verses.modern: David said longingly, "Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is by the gate!"

verses.kjv: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
verses.modern: Then the three broke through the Philistine camp and drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and carried it to David. But David would not drink of it. He poured it out to the LORD

verses.kjv: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.modern: Said, "Far be it from me before my God that I should do this. Shall I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?" For at the risk of their lives they brought it. Therefore He would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

verses.kjv: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.modern: Now Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the three. He wielded his spear against three hundred men and killed them and won a name beside the three.

verses.kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.modern: He was the most renowned of the thirty and became their commander. But He did not attain to the three.

verses.kjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.modern: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a valiant man of Kabzeel, a doer of great deeds. He struck down two heroes of Moab. He also went down and struck down a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen.

verses.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.modern: He struck down an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits tall. The Egyptian had a spear like a weaver's beam, but Benaiah went down to him with a staff and snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed Him with His own spear.

verses.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.modern: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and won a name beside the three mighty men.

verses.kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.modern: He was renowned among the thirty. But he did not attain to the three. And David set him over his bodyguard.

verses.kjv: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.modern: The mighty men of the armies: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

verses.kjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.modern: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

verses.kjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.modern: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

verses.kjv: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.modern: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

verses.kjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.modern: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

verses.kjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.modern: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

verses.kjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.modern: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

verses.kjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.modern: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

verses.kjv: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.modern: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

verses.kjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.modern: Ahiam the son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

verses.kjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.modern: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

verses.kjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.modern: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

verses.kjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.modern: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

verses.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.modern: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.kjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.modern: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.kjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.modern: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

verses.kjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.modern: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a leader of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

verses.kjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.modern: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

verses.kjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.modern: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

verses.kjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.modern: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother the Tizite,

verses.kjv: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.modern: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

verses.kjv: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.modern: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

chapters.summary: All Israel gathered at Hebron and anointed David king; David captured Jerusalem and made it his capital. The chapter lists David’s mighty men and their heroic exploits.

verses.kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
verses.modern: These are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still confined because of Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men who helped in battle.

verses.kjv: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
verses.modern: They were armed with bows and could shoot arrows and sling stones with either the right or the left hand. They were from the tribe of Benjamin, kinsmen of Saul.

verses.kjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
verses.modern: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth; Berachah, Jehu of Anathoth,

verses.kjv: And Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
verses.modern: Ishmaiah of Gibeon, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader over the thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad of Gederah,

verses.kjv: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.modern: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah the Haruphite,

verses.kjv: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.modern: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites,

verses.kjv: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.modern: Joelah and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

verses.kjv: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.modern: From the Gadites there separated themselves to David at the stronghold in the wilderness mighty and experienced warriors, skilled in handling shield and spear, whose faces were like faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:

verses.kjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.modern: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

verses.kjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.modern: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

verses.kjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.modern: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

verses.kjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.modern: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

verses.kjv: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.modern: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.

verses.kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.modern: These Gadites were commanders of the army. The least ranked was equal to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.

verses.kjv: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.modern: These are the men who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was flooding all its banks, and put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.

verses.kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
verses.modern: Some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

verses.kjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
verses.modern: David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies, though my hands have done no wrong, may the God of our fathers see and rebuke it."

verses.kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.modern: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the thirty. He said, "We are Yours, David, and with you, son of Jesse! Peace, peace to You, and peace to Your helpers, for Your God helps You." And David received them and made them commanders of raiding parties.

verses.kjv: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.modern: Some of the men of Manasseh deserted to David when he came with the Philistines for the battle against Saul. Yet he did not help the Philistines, for the rulers of the Philistines took counsel and sent him away, saying, "He will desert to his master Saul at the cost of our heads."

verses.kjv: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.modern: When he went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh deserted to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai — each a commander of a thousand from Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
verses.modern: They helped David against the raiding parties, for they were all mighty warriors and were commanders in the army.

verses.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.modern: For day by day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like an army of God.

verses.kjv: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: These are the numbers of the divisions of the armed troops who came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
verses.modern: The sons of Judah bearing shield and spear: six thousand eight hundred armed troops.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valor for battle: seven thousand one hundred.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.modern: Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with Him were three thousand seven hundred.

verses.kjv: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
verses.modern: Zadok, a young man mighty in valor, and twenty-two commanders from His father's house.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul: three thousand, for until then the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.modern: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were expressly named to come and make David king.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times to know what Israel should do: two hundred chiefs. All their brothers under their command.

verses.kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
verses.modern: Of Zebulun, experienced soldiers equipped for battle with all weapons of war: fifty thousand to join David, not double-hearted.

verses.kjv: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.modern: Of Naphtali: a thousand commanders and with them thirty-seven thousand men armed with shield and spear.

verses.kjv: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.modern: Of the Danites experienced in battle: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.modern: Of Asher, experienced soldiers ready for battle: forty thousand.

verses.kjv: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.modern: From beyond the Jordan, of the Reubenites, Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, equipped with all weapons of war: one hundred twenty thousand.

verses.kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.modern: All these warriors, drawn up in battle order, came to Hebron with full intent to make David king over all Israel. Likewise, all the rest of Israel were of one mind to make David king.

verses.kjv: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.modern: They were there with David for three days, eating and drinking, for their brothers had made preparation for them.

verses.kjv: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen; and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.modern: Also their neighbors, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen — provisions of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, oxen, and sheep in abundance, for there was joy in Israel.

chapters.summary: Warriors from every tribe came to David at Ziklag and Hebron, joining him while he was still hiding from Saul, until a great army assembled to make him king over all Israel.

verses.kjv: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.modern: David consulted with the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader.

verses.kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.modern: David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to You, and if it is the will of the LORD our God, let us send abroad to our brothers who remain in all the lands of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities with pasturelands, that they may be gathered to us.

verses.kjv: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.modern: Then let us bring back the ark of our God to us, for we did not seek it in the days of Saul."

verses.kjv: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.modern: The whole assembly agreed to do so, for the thing seemed right in the eyes of all the people.

verses.kjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
verses.modern: So David assembled all Israel from the Shihor of Egypt to the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

verses.kjv: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
verses.modern: David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim of Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the LORD Who is enthroned above the cherubim, which is called by His name.

verses.kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.modern: They carried the ark of God on a new cart, out of the house of Abinadab. Uzza and Ahio were driving the cart.

verses.kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.modern: David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, with song and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.

verses.kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.modern: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.modern: The anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza. He struck Him down because He put out His hand to the ark. He died there before God.

verses.kjv: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
verses.modern: David was angry because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. That place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

verses.kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.modern: David was afraid of God that day. He said, "How can I bring the ark of God home to me?"

verses.kjv: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.modern: So David did not take the ark home into the city of David, but took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.kjv: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
verses.modern: The ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom in His house for three months. And the LORD blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that He had.

chapters.summary: David gathered all Israel and brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim on a new cart, but when Uzzah touched the ark, the LORD struck him dead. David left the ark at the house of Obed-edom.

verses.kjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.modern: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar timber and masons and carpenters to build a house for him.

verses.kjv: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.modern: David knew that the LORD had established Him as king over Israel, and that His kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of His people Israel.

verses.kjv: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.modern: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David begat more sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.modern: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

verses.kjv: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.modern: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

verses.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.modern: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.kjv: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.modern: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

verses.kjv: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.modern: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. But David heard of it and went out against them.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.modern: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.modern: David inquired of God, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You give them into my hand?" And the LORD said to Him, "Go up. I will give them into Your hand."

verses.kjv: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.modern: They came up to Baal-perazim, and David struck them down there. And David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a bursting flood." Therefore the name of that place is called Baal-perazim.

verses.kjv: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.modern: They left their gods there, and David gave the command. They were burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.modern: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

verses.kjv: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.modern: David again inquired of God. God said to Him, "You shall not go up after them; circle around them and come against them opposite the balsam trees.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.modern: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then go out to battle, for God has gone out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines."

verses.kjv: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.modern: David did as God commanded him. They struck down the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer.

verses.kjv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.modern: The fame of David went out into all lands. The LORD brought the fear of Him on all nations.

chapters.summary: Hiram king of Tyre sent materials and craftsmen to build David a house; David took more wives in Jerusalem and twice defeated the Philistines as God commanded.

verses.kjv: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.modern: David built houses for himself in the city of David. And he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.

verses.kjv: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.modern: Then David said, "No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, for the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of God and to minister to Him forever."

verses.kjv: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.modern: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place He had prepared for it.

verses.kjv: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.modern: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.modern: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, with one hundred twenty of his brothers;

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.modern: Of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, with two hundred twenty of his brothers;

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.modern: Of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, with one hundred thirty of his brothers;

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.modern: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, with two hundred of his brothers;

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.modern: Of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, with eighty of his brothers;

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, with one hundred twelve of his brothers.

verses.kjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.modern: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.modern: He said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites. Consecrate yourselves, You and Your brothers, so that You may bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.

verses.kjv: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.modern: For because You did not carry it the first time, the LORD our God broke out against us, because we did not seek Him according to the proper order."

verses.kjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.modern: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: The Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.modern: David also commanded the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers as the singers who should play on musical instruments, on harps and lyres and cymbals, to raise sounds of joy.

verses.kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.modern: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel. Among his brothers Asaph the son of Berechiah. Among the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

verses.kjv: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.modern: With them their brothers of the second order: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and Obed-edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.modern: The singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound bronze cymbals;

verses.kjv: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.modern: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth;

verses.kjv: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.modern: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith.

verses.kjv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.modern: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, was put in charge of the music, for he was skillful.

verses.kjv: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.modern: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.

verses.kjv: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nathaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.modern: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were also gatekeepers for the ark.

verses.kjv: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
verses.modern: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom with rejoicing.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.modern: Because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

verses.kjv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.modern: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as also were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers and Chenaniah the leader of the music with the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.

verses.kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.modern: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, to the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, and made loud music on harps and lyres.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.modern: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and celebrating. She despised him in her heart.

chapters.summary: David prepared a place for the ark and commanded that only the Levites carry it, correcting the earlier failure. The Levites brought the ark into Jerusalem with shouting, music, and celebration.

verses.kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.modern: So they brought in the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. They offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

verses.kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: When David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, He blessed the people in the name of the LORD

verses.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
verses.modern: Distributed to all Israel, both men and women, to each a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a flagon of wine.

verses.kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
verses.modern: Then He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to invoke, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

verses.kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.modern: Asaph the chief, second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel with harps and lyres; Asaph was to sound the cymbals;

verses.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.modern: Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.modern: On that day David first appointed that thanksgiving be sung to the LORD by Asaph and his brothers.

verses.kjv: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.modern: Give thanks to the LORD; call on His name; make known His deeds among the peoples!

verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.modern: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wondrous works!

verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.modern: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice!

verses.kjv: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.modern: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His presence continually!

verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.modern: Remember the wondrous works that He has done, His miracles and the judgments He has spoken,

verses.kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.modern: O seed of Israel his servant, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones!

verses.kjv: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.modern: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.modern: Remember His covenant forever, the word that He commanded for a thousand generations,

verses.kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.modern: The covenant that he made with Abraham. His sworn promise to Isaac,

verses.kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.modern: Which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,

verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.modern: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, as your portion for an inheritance."

verses.kjv: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.modern: When you were few in number, very few, and sojourners in it,

verses.kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.modern: Wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,

verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.modern: He allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account,

verses.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.modern: Saying, "Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!"

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Tell of His salvation from day to day.

verses.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.modern: Declare His glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples!

verses.kjv: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.modern: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He is to be feared above all gods.

verses.kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.modern: For all the gods of the peoples are idols. But the LORD made the heavens.

verses.kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.modern: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy are in His place.

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.modern: Ascribe to the LORD, O clans of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

verses.kjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.modern: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him! Worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness;

verses.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.modern: Tremble before Him, all the earth! Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved.

verses.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
verses.modern: Let the heavens be glad and let the earth rejoice, and let them say among the nations, "The LORD reigns!"

verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verses.modern: Let the sea roar. All it contains; let the fields rejoice, and everything in them!

verses.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.modern: Then shall the trees of the forest sing for joy before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.modern: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; for His mercy endures forever!

verses.kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
verses.modern: Say also: "Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather and deliver us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in Your praise."

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
verses.modern: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! And all the people said "Amen!" and praised the LORD.

verses.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.modern: Then David left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD to minister regularly before the ark as each day required,

verses.kjv: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
verses.modern: Also Obed-edom and His sixty-eight brothers, while Obed-edom the son of Jeduthun and Hosah were to be gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.modern: He left Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tent of the LORD at the high place that was at Gibeon,

verses.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
verses.modern: To offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering regularly morning and evening, in accordance with all that is written in the Law of the LORD that He commanded Israel.

verses.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.modern: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and expressly named to give thanks to the LORD, for His mercy endures forever.

verses.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
verses.modern: Heman and Jeduthun had trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were appointed to the gate.

verses.kjv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.modern: Then all the people departed each to his house, and David went home to bless his household.

chapters.summary: The ark was set in the tent David had pitched for it, and David appointed Levites to minister before it. David’s psalm of thanksgiving praised the LORD and called on all the earth to worship Him.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.
verses.modern: Now when David lived in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, " I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent."

verses.kjv: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
verses.modern: Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.modern: But that same night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.kjv: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.modern: "Go and tell my servant David, 'Thus says the LORD: You shall not build me a house to dwell in.

verses.kjv: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.modern: For I have not lived in a house since the day I brought up Israel to this day. But I have gone from tent to tent and from one dwelling to another.

verses.kjv: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.modern: In all places where I moved with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people, saying, "Why have You not built me a house of cedar?"'

verses.kjv: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.modern: Now therefore thus shall You say to my servant David, 'Thus says the LORD of hosts, I took You from the pasture, from following the flock, to be prince over my people Israel,

verses.kjv: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.modern: I have been with You wherever You went and have cut off all Your enemies before You. And I will make for You a name, like the name of the great ones of the earth.

verses.kjv: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.modern: I will appoint a place for my people Israel and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be disturbed no more. And the children of wickedness shall waste them no more, as formerly,

verses.kjv: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
verses.modern: From the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will humble all Your enemies. Moreover, I declare to You that the LORD will build You a house.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.modern: When Your days are fulfilled to walk with Your fathers, I will raise up Your seed after You, one of Your own sons. I will establish His kingdom.

verses.kjv: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.modern: He shall build a house for me. I will establish His throne forever.

verses.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
verses.modern: I will be to Him a father. He shall be to me a son. I will not take my mercy from Him, as I took it from Him who was before You,

verses.kjv: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.modern: But I will confirm Him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne shall be established forever.' "

verses.kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.modern: In accordance with all these words and all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.

verses.kjv: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.modern: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD and said, "Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house that You have brought me this far?

verses.kjv: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
verses.modern: This was a small thing in Your eyes, O God. You have also spoken of Your servant's house for a great while to come, and have shown me future generations, O LORD God!

verses.kjv: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.modern: What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant.

verses.kjv: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.modern: For Your servant's sake, O LORD, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

verses.kjv: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.modern: There is none like You, O LORD, and there is no God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.modern: Who is like Your people Israel, the one nation on earth whom God went to redeem to be His people, making Yourself a name for great and awesome things by driving out nations before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt?

verses.kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
verses.modern: You made Your people Israel to be Your people forever, and You, O LORD, became their God.

verses.kjv: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.modern: Now, O LORD, let the word that You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning His house be confirmed forever, and do as You have promised.

verses.kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
verses.modern: Let it be confirmed and Your name be magnified forever, saying, 'The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, is Israel's God,' and the house of Your servant David will be established before you.

verses.kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
verses.modern: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build Him a house. Therefore Your servant has found courage to pray before You.

verses.kjv: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.modern: Now, O LORD, You are God, and You have promised this good thing to Your servant.

verses.kjv: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.modern: Now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You, for it is You, O LORD, who have blessed. It is blessed forever."

chapters.summary: David told Nathan the prophet he wanted to build a house for God, but the LORD sent word that David’s son would build the temple. God promised David an everlasting dynasty, and David responded in prayer and worship.

verses.kjv: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.modern: After this David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.modern: He defeated Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

verses.kjv: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.modern: David also defeated Hadarezer king of Zobah toward Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

verses.kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.modern: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough for a hundred chariots.

verses.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.modern: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

verses.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.modern: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus, and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. And the LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

verses.kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: David took the golden shields that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.modern: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a great amount of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze sea and the pillars and the vessels of bronze.

verses.kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.modern: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

verses.kjv: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.modern: He sent his son Hadoram to King David, to greet him and to congratulate him because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him — for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou — and all kinds of articles of gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.modern: These also King David dedicated to the LORD, together with the silver and gold that He had carried off from all the nations: from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and from Amalek.

verses.kjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.modern: Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

verses.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.modern: He put garrisons in Edom. All the Edomites became David's servants. And the LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

verses.kjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.modern: So David reigned over all Israel. He administered justice and equity to all his people.

verses.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder;
verses.modern: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.modern: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.modern: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and David's sons were the chief officials in the service of the king.

chapters.summary: David defeated the Philistines, Moabites, Hadarezer of Zobah, and the Syrians, establishing his empire. David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and judgment to all his people.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: After this Nahash the king of the Ammonites died. His son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.modern: David said, "I will deal loyally with Hanun the son of Nahash, for his father dealt loyally with me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to comfort him.

verses.kjv: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.modern: But the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun, "Do you think that David is honoring your father because he has sent comforters to you? Have not his servants come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?"

verses.kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.modern: So Hanun took David's servants and shaved them and cut off their garments in the middle, at their hips, and sent them away.

verses.kjv: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.modern: When David was told about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for the men were greatly humiliated. And the king said, "Remain at Jericho until your beards have grown and then return."

verses.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.modern: When the Ammonites saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Syria-maacah, and from Zobah.

verses.kjv: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.modern: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots and the king of Maacah with his army, who came and encamped before Medeba. And the Ammonites were gathered from their cities and came to battle.

verses.kjv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.modern: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

verses.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.modern: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle array at the entrance of the city, and the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.
