verses.kjv: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.modern: When Joab saw that the battle was set against him both in front and in the rear, he chose some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Syrians.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.modern: The rest of the people he put in the charge of his brother Abishai. They were arrayed against the Ammonites.

verses.kjv: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.modern: He said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will help you.

verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.
verses.modern: Be strong, and let us act courageously for our people and for the cities of our God, and may the LORD do what seems good to Him."

verses.kjv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.modern: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near before the Syrians for battle. They fled before Him.

verses.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: When the Ammonites saw that the Syrians fled, they likewise fled before His brother Abishai and entered the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.modern: But when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the Euphrates, with Shophach the commander of the army of Hadadezer at their head.

verses.kjv: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So David set the battle in array against the Syrians, and they fought with him.
verses.modern: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan and came to them and drew up his forces against them. When David set the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

verses.kjv: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of their host.
verses.modern: The Syrians fled before Israel, and David killed of the Syrians seven thousand men who rode in chariots and forty thousand foot soldiers. He put to death Shophach the commander of their army.

verses.kjv: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.modern: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants. So the Syrians were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.

chapters.summary: David sent messengers to comfort Hanun king of Ammon, but Hanun humiliated them by shaving their beards and cutting their garments. Joab and Abishai defeated the Ammonites and their Syrian allies in battle.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
verses.modern: In the spring of the year, at the time when kings go out to battle, Joab led out the army and ravaged the country of the Ammonites and came and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem. And Joab struck down Rabbah and overthrew it.

verses.kjv: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
verses.modern: David took the crown of their king from his head and found that it weighed a talent of gold, and there was a precious stone in it. It was placed on David's head. And he brought out a very great amount of spoil from the city.

verses.kjv: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: He brought out the people who were in it and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Thus David did to all the cities of the Ammonites. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
verses.modern: After this there arose war with the Philistines at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, who was one of the descendants of the giants. They were subdued.

verses.kjv: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.
verses.modern: There was war again with the Philistines, and Elhanan the son of Jair struck down Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

verses.kjv: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
verses.modern: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot — twenty-four in all — and he also was descended from the giants.

verses.kjv: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
verses.modern: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, struck him down.

verses.kjv: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.modern: These were descended from the giants in Gath. They fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

chapters.summary: Joab besieged and captured Rabbah of the Ammonites, and David took their king’s crown. Israelite warriors killed three Philistine giants who were descendants of the giant in Gath.

verses.kjv: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.modern: Then Satan stood against Israel and incited David to number Israel.

verses.kjv: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
verses.modern: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the people, "Go, number Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, and bring me a report, that I may know their number."

verses.kjv: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.modern: But Joab said, "May the LORD add to His people a hundred times as many as they are! Are they not, my lord the king, all of them my lord's servants? Why then should my lord require this? Why should it be a cause of guilt for Israel?"

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: But the king's word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and went throughout all Israel and came back to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.modern: Joab gave the sum of the numbering of the people to David. In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and in Judah four hundred seventy thousand who drew the sword.

verses.kjv: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
verses.modern: But he did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, for the king's command was abhorrent to Joab.

verses.kjv: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.modern: But God was displeased with this thing. He struck Israel.

verses.kjv: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.modern: David said to God, "I have sinned greatly in that I have done this thing. But now, please take away the iniquity of your servant, for I have acted very foolishly."

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,

verses.kjv: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.modern: "Go and say to David, 'Thus says the LORD, Three things I offer You; choose one of them, that I may do it to You.' "

verses.kjv: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
verses.modern: So Gad came to David and said to him, "Thus says the LORD, 'Choose what You will:

verses.kjv: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
verses.modern: Either three years of famine, or three months of devastation by Your foes, with the sword of Your enemies overtaking You, or else three days of the sword of the LORD, pestilence on the land, with the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the territory of Israel.' Now decide what answer I shall return to Him who sent me."

verses.kjv: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.modern: Then David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great, but do not let me fall into the hand of man."

verses.kjv: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.modern: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

verses.kjv: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.modern: God sent the angel to Jerusalem to destroy it, but as he was about to destroy it, the LORD saw and repented Him of the evil and said to the angel who was working destruction, "It is enough; now stay Your hand." And the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.modern: David lifted his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between earth and heaven, and in His hand a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

verses.kjv: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.modern: David said to God, "Was it not I who commanded the people to be counted? It is I who have sinned and done great evil. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, let Your hand be against me and against my father's house. But do not let the plague be on Your people."

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.modern: Now the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to tell David to go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: So David went up at Gad's word, which he had spoken in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.modern: Now Ornan turned and saw the angel. His four sons who were with him hid themselves. Ornan was threshing wheat.

verses.kjv: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.modern: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David and went out from the threshing floor and paid homage to David with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.modern: David said to Ornan, "Give me the site of the threshing floor that I may build on it an altar to the LORD — give it to me at its full price — that the plague may be averted from the people."

verses.kjv: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.modern: Then Ornan said to David, "Take it, and let my lord the king do what seems good to him. See, I give the oxen for the burnt offerings and the threshing sledges for the wood and the wheat for the grain offering. I give it all."

verses.kjv: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.modern: But King David said to Ornan, "No. But I will buy them for the full price. I will not take for the LORD what is Yours, nor offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing."

verses.kjv: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.modern: So David paid Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the site.

verses.kjv: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.modern: David built there an altar to the LORD and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings and called on the LORD. He answered Him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.modern: Then the LORD commanded the angel. He put his sword back into its sheath.

verses.kjv: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.modern: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered Him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, He sacrificed there.

verses.kjv: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.modern: For the tent of the LORD that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were at that time in the high place at Gibeon,

verses.kjv: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
verses.modern: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, for He was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

chapters.summary: Satan incited David to number Israel; God sent a plague that killed seventy thousand men. David bought the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite and built an altar there, and the LORD answered with fire from heaven.

verses.kjv: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.modern: Then David said, "Here shall be the house of the LORD God and here the altar of burnt offering for Israel."

verses.kjv: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.modern: David commanded to gather together the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel. He set stonecutters to prepare dressed stones for building the house of God.

verses.kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.modern: David also provided great quantities of iron for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the clamps, and so much bronze it could not be weighed;

verses.kjv: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.modern: Cedar timber without limit, for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought great quantities of cedar to David.

verses.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.modern: For David said, "Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be greatly magnificent, famous and glorious throughout all lands. I will therefore make preparation for it." So David prepared abundantly before his death.

verses.kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
verses.modern: Then He called for Solomon his son and charged him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
verses.modern: David said to Solomon, "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

verses.kjv: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.modern: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, 'You have shed much blood and have waged great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because You have shed so much blood before me on the earth.

verses.kjv: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.modern: A son shall be born to you who shall be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his surrounding enemies. For his name shall be Solomon. I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.

verses.kjv: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.modern: He shall build a house for my name. He shall be my son. I will be his father. I will establish his royal throne in Israel forever.'

verses.kjv: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
verses.modern: Now, my son, the LORD be with You, so that You may succeed in building the house of the LORD Your God, as He has spoken concerning You.

verses.kjv: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
verses.modern: Only may the LORD grant You discretion and understanding, that when He gives You charge over Israel You may keep the law of the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
verses.modern: Then You will prosper if You are careful to observe the statutes and the rules that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Fear not; do not be dismayed.

verses.kjv: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.modern: With great pains I have provided for the house of the LORD one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond weighing, for there is so much of it; timber and stone too I have provided. To these You must add more.

verses.kjv: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
verses.modern: You have an abundance of workmen: stonecutters, masons, carpenters. All kinds of craftsmen without number, skilled in working

verses.kjv: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
verses.modern: Gold, silver, bronze, and iron. Arise and do it! May the LORD be with You."

verses.kjv: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.modern: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

verses.kjv: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
verses.modern: "Is not the LORD Your God with You? And has He not given You rest on every side? For He has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land is subdued before the LORD and before His people.

verses.kjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: Now set Your heart and soul to seek the LORD Your God. Arise and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God may be brought into a house built for the name of the LORD."

chapters.summary: David declared that the temple would be built on Ornan’s threshing floor and began gathering materials in abundance. He charged Solomon his son to build the house of the LORD and commanded the leaders of Israel to help him.

verses.kjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.modern: When David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

verses.kjv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.modern: David assembled all the leaders of Israel and the priests and the Levites.

verses.kjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.modern: The Levites, thirty years old and upward, were counted, and the total number was thirty-eight thousand men.

verses.kjv: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.modern: "Twenty-four thousand of these," David said, "shall have charge of the work in the house of the LORD, six thousand shall be officers and judges,

verses.kjv: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
verses.modern: Four thousand gatekeepers, and four thousand shall offer praises to the LORD with the instruments that I have made for praise."

verses.kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.modern: David organized them in divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.modern: The sons of Gershon: Ladan and Shimei.

verses.kjv: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.modern: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel — three.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.modern: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran — three. These were the heads of the fathers' houses of Ladan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.modern: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zizah, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

verses.kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
verses.modern: Jahath was the chief and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were enrolled as a single father's house.

verses.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.modern: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel — four.

verses.kjv: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.modern: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart to dedicate the most holy things, that He and His sons should burn incense before the LORD, and minister to Him and pronounce blessings in His name forever.

verses.kjv: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.modern: But as for Moses the man of God, His sons were enrolled in the tribe of Levi.

verses.kjv: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.modern: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.modern: The son of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.modern: The sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.modern: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.modern: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
verses.modern: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief and Isshiah the second.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.modern: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.modern: Eleazar died having no sons, only daughters; their brothers the sons of Kish married them.

verses.kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.modern: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth — three.

verses.kjv: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.modern: These were the sons of Levi by their fathers' houses, the heads of fathers' houses as they were listed by name individually, who did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from twenty years old and upward.

verses.kjv: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.modern: For David said, "The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem forever.

verses.kjv: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.modern: So the Levites no longer need to carry the tent or any of the things for its service."

verses.kjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.modern: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered from twenty years old and upward.

verses.kjv: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.modern: For their duty was to assist the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, caring for the courts and the chambers, the cleansing of all that is holy, and any work for the service of the house of God.

verses.kjv: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.modern: Their duties were also for the bread of the Presence, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil. All measures of quantity and size.

verses.kjv: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
verses.modern: They were to stand every morning, thanking and praising the LORD, and likewise at evening,

verses.kjv: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
verses.modern: Whenever burnt offerings were offered to the LORD on Sabbaths, new moons, and feast days, according to the number required of them, regularly before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Thus they were to keep charge of the tent of meeting and charge of the holy place, and to attend the sons of Aaron, their brothers, for the service of the house of the LORD.

chapters.summary: When David was old, he made Solomon king and numbered the Levites from thirty years old and upward. He organized the Levites into divisions for the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.modern: These are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.modern: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

verses.kjv: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.modern: With the help of Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, David organized them according to their appointed duties in their service.

verses.kjv: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: Since more leaders were found among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar, they were organized accordingly: sixteen heads of fathers' houses from the sons of Eleazar, and eight from the sons of Ithamar.

verses.kjv: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.modern: They were organized by lot, one group as well as the other, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.

verses.kjv: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.modern: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel, a Levite scribe, recorded them before the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the priests and of the Levites — one father's house being chosen for Eleazar and one chosen for Ithamar.

verses.kjv: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.modern: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

verses.kjv: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.modern: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

verses.kjv: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.modern: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

verses.kjv: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.modern: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

verses.kjv: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.modern: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

verses.kjv: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.modern: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

verses.kjv: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.modern: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

verses.kjv: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.modern: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

verses.kjv: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.modern: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

verses.kjv: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.modern: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

verses.kjv: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.modern: The twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

verses.kjv: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.modern: The twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

verses.kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.modern: These had their appointed duties in their service to come into the house of the LORD according to the procedure established for them by Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded Him.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.modern: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

verses.kjv: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.modern: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah was the chief.

verses.kjv: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.modern: Of the Izharites: Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.modern: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.modern: The son of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

verses.kjv: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.modern: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.modern: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziah: Beno.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.modern: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

verses.kjv: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.modern: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.kjv: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.modern: Of Kish: the son of Kish, Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.modern: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.

verses.kjv: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.modern: These also cast lots corresponding to their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the priests and Levites, the chief fathers corresponding to their younger brothers.

chapters.summary: David divided the descendants of Aaron into twenty-four divisions by lot for their priestly duties. The remaining Levites were likewise organized by lot for their service.

verses.kjv: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.modern: David and the commanders of the army set apart for the service the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who prophesied with lyres, harps, and cymbals. The list of those who did the work and their duties:

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.modern: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah, sons of Asaph, under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.

verses.kjv: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
verses.modern: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah — six — under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre in thanksgiving and praise to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
verses.modern: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

verses.kjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.modern: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.kjv: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.modern: All these were under the direction of their father in the music in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, harps, and lyres for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the order of the king.

verses.kjv: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.modern: The number of them along with their brothers who were trained in singing to the LORD, all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

verses.kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.modern: They cast lots for their duties, the small and the great alike, the teacher and the student.

verses.kjv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
verses.modern: The first lot fell for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and his sons, twelve;

verses.kjv: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The thirteenth to Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.modern: The twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.kjv: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
verses.modern: The twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

chapters.summary: David and the army commanders set apart the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophetic music. Twenty-four divisions of temple musicians were assigned by lot, twelve men per division.

verses.kjv: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.modern: As for the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.modern: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

verses.kjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.modern: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.

verses.kjv: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
verses.modern: Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

verses.kjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
verses.modern: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth, for God blessed him.

verses.kjv: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
verses.modern: Also to his son Shemaiah were sons born who ruled over their father's house, for they were mighty men of valor.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.modern: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers were able men — Elihu and Semachiah.

verses.kjv: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
verses.modern: All these were among the sons of Obed-edom with their sons and brothers, able men qualified for the service — sixty-two of Obed-edom.

verses.kjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
verses.modern: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, able men — eighteen.

verses.kjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
verses.modern: Hosah, of the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him chief),

verses.kjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.modern: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

verses.kjv: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: These divisions of the gatekeepers, corresponding to their chief men, had duties, just as their brothers did, ministering in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
verses.modern: They cast lots by fathers' houses, small and great alike, for each gate.

verses.kjv: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.modern: The lot for the east fell to Shelemiah. They cast lots also for his son Zechariah, a shrewd counselor. His lot came out for the north.

verses.kjv: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
verses.modern: Obed-edom's lot came out for the south, and to his sons the storehouse.

verses.kjv: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
verses.modern: For Shuppim and Hosah it came out for the west, by the gate of Shallecheth on the road that goes up. Watch was opposite watch.

verses.kjv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
verses.modern: On the east there were six each day, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, and at the storehouse two and two.

verses.kjv: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.modern: At the Parbar on the west there were four at the road and two at the Parbar.

verses.kjv: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
verses.modern: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Korah and the sons of Merari.

verses.kjv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.modern: Of the Levites, Ahijah had charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated gifts.

verses.kjv: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
verses.modern: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonite Ladan, the heads of the fathers' houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

verses.kjv: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham and Joel his brother, who were over the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.modern: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

verses.kjv: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
verses.modern: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

verses.kjv: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.modern: His brothers through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

verses.kjv: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.modern: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated gifts that David the king, and the heads of the fathers' houses, and the officers of the thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army had dedicated.

verses.kjv: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: From the spoils of wars they dedicated gifts for the maintenance of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.modern: Also all that Samuel the seer had dedicated, and Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah — whatever anyone had dedicated was in the care of Shelomoth and his brothers.

verses.kjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.modern: Of the Izharites: Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to outside duties for Israel as officers and judges.

verses.kjv: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
verses.modern: Of the Hebronites: Hashabiah and His brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of ability, had the oversight of Israel west of the Jordan for all the LORD's business and for the service of the king.

verses.kjv: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.modern: Among the Hebronites, Jerijah was chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of their fathers. In the fortieth year of David's reign search was made, and men of great ability were found among them at Jazer in Gilead.

verses.kjv: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
verses.modern: King David appointed him and his brothers — two thousand seven hundred men of ability, heads of fathers' houses — over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

chapters.summary: The gatekeepers were organized by divisions from the families of Korah and Merari, with assignments to the four sides of the temple. Other Levites were appointed over the treasuries and as officers and judges.

verses.kjv: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: This is the list of the people of Israel — the heads of fathers' houses, the commanders of thousands and hundreds. Their officers who served the king in all matters of the divisions that came and went, month after month throughout the year. Each division numbered twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division in the first month; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.modern: He was one of the sons of Perez and was chief of all the commanders for the first month.

verses.kjv: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division of the second month; in his division were twenty-four thousand, and Mikloth was the chief officer.

verses.kjv: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The third commander, for the third month, was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada the priest, as chief; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.modern: This is the Benaiah who was a mighty man of the thirty and in command of the thirty; Ammizabad his son was in charge of his division.

verses.kjv: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab, and after him Zebadiah his son; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The fifth, for the fifth month, was Shamhuth the Izrahite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephraim; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer of Anathoth, a Benjaminite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the sons of Ephraim; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.modern: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.modern: Over the tribes of Israel: for the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was chief; for the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

verses.kjv: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.modern: For Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok;

verses.kjv: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.modern: For Judah, Elihu, one of David's brothers; for Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

verses.kjv: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.modern: For Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel;

verses.kjv: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.modern: For the sons of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; for the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

verses.kjv: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.modern: For the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

verses.kjv: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: For Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.modern: David did not number those below twenty years of age, for the LORD had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven.

verses.kjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.modern: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to count but did not finish. Wrath came upon Israel because of this, and the number was not entered in the chronicles of King David.

verses.kjv: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.modern: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was over the king's treasuries. Jehonathan the son of Uzziah was over the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers.

verses.kjv: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.modern: Ezri the son of Chelub was over those who worked the fields and tilled the ground.

verses.kjv: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.modern: Shimei the Ramathite was over the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was over the produce of the vineyards for the wine cellars.

verses.kjv: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.modern: Baal-hanan the Gederite was over the olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah; Joash was over the stores of oil.

verses.kjv: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.modern: Shitrai the Sharonite was over the herds that grazed in Sharon; Shaphat the son of Adlai was over the herds in the valleys.

verses.kjv: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.modern: Obil the Ishmaelite was over the camels; Jehdeiah the Meronothite was over the donkeys.

verses.kjv: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
verses.modern: Jaziz the Hagrite was over the flocks. All these were the stewards of King David's property.

verses.kjv: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
verses.modern: Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor — he was a man of understanding and also a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni attended the king's sons.

verses.kjv: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
verses.modern: Ahithophel was the king's counselor, and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.

verses.kjv: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
verses.modern: After Ahithophel came Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. The commander of the king's army was Joab.

chapters.summary: The twelve monthly military divisions are listed, each with twenty-four thousand men and a commander. The chapter also records the tribal leaders, David’s overseers of royal property, and his counselors.

verses.kjv: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
verses.modern: David assembled at Jerusalem all the leaders of Israel — the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of the divisions that served the king, the commanders of thousands, the commanders of hundreds, the stewards of all the property and livestock of the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the mighty men and all the valiant men, to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
verses.modern: Then King David rose to his feet and said: "Hear me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and for the footstool of our God. I made preparations for building.

verses.kjv: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.modern: But God said to me, 'You may not build a house for my name, for You are a man of war and have shed blood.'

verses.kjv: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
verses.modern: Yet the LORD God of Israel chose me from all my father's house to be king over Israel forever. For He chose Judah as leader, and in the house of Judah my father's house, and among my father's sons He took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

verses.kjv: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
verses.modern: Of all my sons — for the LORD has given me many sons — He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.modern: He said to me, 'It is Solomon your son who shall build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son. I will be his father.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.modern: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues resolute in keeping my commandments and my rules, as he is today.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
verses.modern: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, observe and seek all the commandments of the LORD Your God, that You may possess this good land and leave it for an inheritance to Your children after You forever.

verses.kjv: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.modern: You, Solomon my son, know the God of Your father and serve Him with a whole heart and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches all hearts and understands every plan and thought. If You seek Him, He will be found by You, but if You forsake Him, He will cast You off forever.

verses.kjv: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.modern: Take care now, for the LORD has chosen You to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong and do it."

verses.kjv: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
verses.modern: Then David gave Solomon his son the plan of the vestibule of the temple, and of its houses, its treasuries, its upper rooms, and its inner rooms, and of the room for the mercy seat;

verses.kjv: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
verses.modern: The plan of all that He had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, all the surrounding chambers, the treasuries of the house of God, and the treasuries for dedicated gifts;

verses.kjv: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: For the divisions of the priests and of the Levites. All the work of the service in the house of the LORD; for all the vessels for the service in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
verses.modern: He gave Him the weight of gold for all golden vessels for each service, the weight of silver vessels for each service,

verses.kjv: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
verses.modern: The weight of the golden lampstands and their lamps of gold, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps. The weight of silver for a lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand.

verses.kjv: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
verses.modern: He gave the weight of gold for each table for the bread of the Presence. The weight of silver for the tables of silver;

verses.kjv: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
verses.modern: Pure gold for the forks, the basins, and the cups; for the golden bowls and the weight of each; for the silver bowls and the weight of each;

verses.kjv: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.modern: For the altar of incense made of refined gold, and its weight; also His plan for the golden chariot of the cherubim that spread their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

verses.kjv: All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
verses.modern: "All this He made clear to me in writing from the hand of the LORD, all the work to be done according to the plan."

verses.kjv: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: Then David said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous and do it. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with You. He will not leave You or forsake You, until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
verses.modern: The divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of the house of God — every willing man who has skill for any kind of service is with You. The leaders and all the people will be fully at your command."

chapters.summary: David assembled all the leaders of Israel and publicly charged Solomon to build the temple, presenting him with the divinely inspired plans for every detail of the house of God and its service.

verses.kjv: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
verses.modern: David the king said to all the assembly, "Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and the work is great, for the palace will not be for man but for the LORD God.

verses.kjv: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.modern: So I have provided for the house of my God, so far as I was able, the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, the iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, besides great quantities of onyx and stones for setting, antimony, colored stones, all sorts of precious stones, and marble.

verses.kjv: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verses.modern: Moreover, in addition to all that I have provided for the holy house, I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, and because of my devotion to the house of my God I give it to the house of my God:

verses.kjv: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
verses.modern: Three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for overlaying the walls of the houses,

verses.kjv: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?
verses.modern: For all the work to be done by craftsmen — gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver. Who then will offer willingly, consecrating Himself today to the LORD?"

verses.kjv: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
verses.modern: Then the leaders of fathers' houses made their freewill offerings, as did also the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officers over the king's work.

verses.kjv: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.modern: They gave for the service of the house of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.kjv: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.modern: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, in the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.kjv: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.modern: Then the people rejoiced because these had given willingly, for with a whole heart they had offered freely to the LORD. David the king also rejoiced greatly.

verses.kjv: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
verses.modern: Therefore David blessed the LORD in the presence of all the assembly. David said: "Blessed are you, O LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

verses.kjv: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.modern: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty, for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is Yours. Yours is the kingdom, O LORD, and You are exalted as head above all.

verses.kjv: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.modern: Both riches and honor come from You, and You rule over all. In Your hand are power and might, and in Your hand it is to make great and to give strength to all.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
verses.modern: Now we thank You, our God, and praise Your glorious name.

verses.kjv: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
verses.modern: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer willingly like this? For all things come from You, and of Your own have we given You.
